body.name: Unequal-logging switching-winner witness
body.construction: For \(d=2\) and \(K=3\), let \(p_1=p_2=1/2\), \((e_{11},e_{21},e_{31})=(1/2,1/3,1/6)\), \((e_{12},e_{22},e_{32})=(1/6,1/3,1/2)\), \((\mu_{11},\mu_{21},\mu_{31})=(9/10,1/2,1/5)\), and \((\mu_{12},\mu_{22},\mu_{32})=(1/4,3/5,41/50)\); conditionally on \(X\), draw the Bernoulli potential outcomes independently with these means, draw \(A\) independently from the displayed propensity vector, and set \(Y=Y(A)\).
